summary: Phase 9H frontend verification: (1) Customer duplicate warning appears within ~0.5s when entering existing WhatsApp '+628111000999', shows dup-item-<id> with 'cocok pada: whatsapp' text, is NON-BLOCKING (customer-save-button remains enabled). Warning is cleared when whatsapp is cleared or changed to a unique value. (2) Payment overpayment: entering 999.999.999 as amount produces backend 400 and a toast/text containing 'melebihi outstanding' — dialog stays open. Valid amount 50000 succeeds (toast 'Pembayaran dicatat', Terbayar went from Rp 100.000 to Rp 150.000, active payment shown). RBAC: pages accessible for Super Admin. All required flows for Phase 9H pass on UI.
